name: Concentrated solar power with storage
principle: Mirrors concentrate sunlight on a receiver; the heat is stored in molten salt and used to raise steam for a turbine, giving dispatchable solar. NREL's 2024 baseline is a 102 MWe molten-salt power tower with 10 hours of two-tank storage, costed at $7,912/kWe in the 2022 base year.

performance.metric: capacity factor with 10 h storage, base year
